description: Window filtering must be exact: [current_start, current_end) with an inclusive lower bound and exclusive upper bound. PR_801 sits exactly on current_start (included), PR_802 is created one second before it (so it falls into the baseline for review-wait, which anchors on creation/ready time) but merges inside the current window (so it counts as current for cycle time, merge-wait, and PR size, which anchor on merged_at), PR_803 exactly on current_end == analysis_at (excluded from current -- it hasn't existed for any duration within the window yet), and PR_804 crosses a UTC midnight rollover to catch date-only comparison bugs.

pull_requests.author: alice
pull_requests.note: created exactly AT current_start -- included in current window (inclusive lower bound)

pull_requests.author: bob
pull_requests.note: created ONE SECOND before current_start -- baseline for review-wait (anchored on creation; baseline_end is exclusive and equals current_start), but merged at 14:59:59 inside the current window, so current for cycle time, merge-wait, and PR size (anchored on merged_at)

pull_requests.author: carol
pull_requests.note: created exactly AT current_end == analysis_at -- excluded from current window (exclusive upper bound); still counts in point-in-time pending_review_count with 0 days idle

pull_requests.author: dave
pull_requests.note: crosses UTC midnight between creation and merge -- catches date-only (instead of full timestamp) comparison bugs

expected.findings_rationale: No rule fires -- purpose is exact boundary placement (PR_801 in; PR_802 baseline for creation-anchored review-wait but current for merge-anchored metrics, since it merged after current_start; PR_803 out of both windows entirely) and correct sub-day arithmetic across a UTC midnight (PR_804), not a finding.
